create.name: Tony Samara
create.bio:
Tony Samara is a meditation teacher and author now based in Ljubljana, Slovenia, who has spent more than forty years on a contemplative path. As a young man he practised in Zen Buddhism and then lived for years among shamanic communities in South America, training in the Huachuma tradition of the Andes, an experience he later described in his first book, Shaman's Wisdom. Over time his emphasis moved from shamanic ceremony towards a quieter teaching on consciousness, presence and the symbolic meaning of everyday events.

Today he teaches almost entirely online and in both English and Portuguese. He leads live series of energy transmissions and teaching called The Pillar, gives private consultations by video call, offers recorded courses on bringing meditation into daily life and on conscious parenting, and sends free and paid weekly letters on Substack about mysticism and gratitude. His books include Shaman's Wisdom Within, Discover Your Inner Buddha, Ancient Wisdom for Reality Creators and Different Yet the Same, written with the anthropologist Christian Ghasarian. On YouTube and Insight Timer he shares guided meditations, sung prayers and reflective music, and he holds a daily evening sound meditation online.

books.title: Shaman's Wisdom: Reclaim Your Lost Connection With the Universe
books.author: Tony Samara
books.description: His first book, recounting the years he spent learning from shamans in South America and what the Huachuma tradition taught him. It sets out how that older way of seeing can inform a modern spiritual life.

books.title: Shaman's Wisdom Within
books.author: Tony Samara
books.description: A follow-up to Shaman's Wisdom, arranged as a personal inner retreat in twenty-five short teachings. Each chapter offers a reflection and a practice drawn from his shamanic and contemplative background.

books.title: Discover Your Inner Buddha
books.author: Tony Samara
books.description: Reflections that draw on Jesus, the Buddha, Rumi and Kabir to point towards the stillness and love he sees as our true nature. It was first published under the title From the Heart.

books.title: Ancient Wisdom for Reality Creators: 50 Pages That Could Change Your Life
books.author: Tony Samara
books.description: A short, practical book of steps for living more consciously, built on the idea that inner clarity shapes the life we go on to create.

books.title: Different Yet the Same: The mysterious simplicity of spiritual life
books.author: Tony Samara, Christian Ghasarian
books.description: Written with the anthropologist Christian Ghasarian, this book looks at the plain, shared core of spiritual life that lies beneath the outward differences between traditions.

books.title: Deeper than Words: The Teachings of Tony Samara Volume 2
books.author: Tony Samara
books.description: Transcribed talks and question-and-answer sessions from his live satsangs. The themes include presence, love, letting go and the spiritual meaning of ordinary life.

courses.title: Everyday Transformation
courses.description: A recorded course in eleven modules on making meditation part of ordinary life. It moves through presence, conscious breathing, intention, listening, emotions and self-judgement, closing with gratitude and deeper awareness.

courses.title: Conscious Parenting
courses.description: A five-module course with audio, video and a workbook on bringing more awareness into family life. It looks at the difficult everyday moments with children and how a parent can respond with presence rather than reaction.

courses.title: Consultations with Tony Samara
courses.description: Private 30- or 60-minute sessions by Zoom, Skype or Telegram, combining conversation with his energy work. Times are given in Central European time and payment in two instalments is possible.

courses.title: Consciousness & Inner Transformation (paid Substack)
courses.description: His Substack membership, with a weekly letter for paid readers, the full archive and two text courses, Transform Your Life with Mindfulness and Quietening the Mind. Free readers receive a separate weekly letter.
courses.price: €10 EUR a month or €50 EUR a year

free_resources.title: Tony Samara on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, sung prayers, reflections and meditative music, some in Portuguese. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Overcoming Challenges in Meditation: A Free PDF
free_resources.description: A free booklet on the obstacles that come up as a meditation practice matures, including the subtler ones met by experienced meditators. It stresses patience and steady practice.

free_resources.title: Forgiveness in a Nutshell: A Free PDF
free_resources.description: A short free booklet on forgiveness as a spiritual practice, available in English and in Portuguese.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 14.9k (profile, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube @TonySamara 6.5K subscribers (channel page, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram @tonysamarameditation 3,053 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); Facebook not checked/not linked from his site → ~24.5k total → local_hero
flags: Works in both English and Portuguese (site, newsletter and many YouTube titles are bilingual); English is still his main teaching language.
Earlier in his career he was presented as a healer whom people with cancer and AIDS consulted (JC book review); none of that is in the plan, but a human may want to be aware of it.

Book ASINs were confirmed from amazon.com product-page titles in search results; amazon.com /dp/ pages returned 500 on every direct try. Shaman's Wisdom (1452546983) and Shaman's Wisdom Within (1910808008) may be out of print or unavailable new.
Different Yet the Same (2491152037) is co-authored with Christian Ghasarian and appears to be a French-published English edition.
First photo is a signed Podia content-assets URL from his own site; it loaded without cookies but could change if he re-uploads it. Second is his YouTube avatar (same person).
Bio details on his Zen and Huachuma training come from his book listing and interview titles plus the JC review; his own site gives almost no biography.
Email contact@tonysamara.com is a general inbox (on the FAQ and Legacy pages).
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied on the quoted segments and his own site pages.
left_out: Beautiful Breathing (10-day course, also his only Insight Timer course) and Advanced Beautiful Breathing (€32.95 EUR): sales copy says the practice helps the immune system fend off disease.
Sleep Well / Durma Bem / Dobro spite courses: sleep-problem framing.
Detox Body, Mind and Soul (14-day healing programme) and Guide to a Healthier Way of Eating: health and detox claims.
Meditation for Living a Fulfilling Life free PDF: blurb names blood pressure, pain and sleep.
The Pillar 6 live series (€45 EUR, started 28 Oct 2026) and Energy Transmission events (€17.50/€22 EUR, dated): already started or dated.
Reflective Consciousness Certificate Training and Meditation Teacher Training: closed for sign-up.
Daily 9pm CEST online sound meditation: no page of its own.
YouTube: recent uploads are mainly music videos and sleep affirmation tracks; Unintentional ASMR re-uploads by other channels excluded.
Simplicity of Love Meditation and Teachings of Osho and Tony Samara Revealed: no amazon.com listing confirmed.
